name: BookSteam
description_en:
BookSteam combines appointment, class and resource scheduling with customer records and payment-related administration. Businesses can offer a booking page and manage staff, locations and service availability in the same scheduling product.

A meaningful evaluation checks which staff member and room a booking occupies, what the customer can change, and whether payment and reminder conditions match the business policy. The catalogue category alone does not explain those details; this profile uses the official feature and plan pages.
description_zh:
BookSteam 把预约、班课和资源排程，与客户记录及付款相关管理结合起来。企业可以提供预约页面，并在同一排程产品中管理员工、地点和服务可用性。

有效评估应核对一次预约占用哪位员工和哪间房，客户可以修改什么，以及付款和提醒条件是否符合业务政策。仅有目录分类无法说明这些细节，本文依据官方功能与套餐页展开。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate services/classes with locations and reserve rooms or other resources.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把服务和班课关联到地点，并预留房间等资源。

core_features.explanation_en: Customer accounts can create, reschedule and cancel appointments.
core_features.explanation_zh: 客户账户可创建、改期和取消预约。

core_features.name_zh: 通过支付处理商收取订金
core_features.explanation_en: The feature page names Square, Stripe and PayPal for online card processing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 功能页列出通过 Square、Stripe 和 PayPal 处理在线银行卡付款。

en: A clinic evaluating a session should model the practitioner, location and room as separate constraints. BookSteam describes resource reservations and assignment of services, classes or workshops to locations and staff. Build an intake form for the information needed before the visit, then inspect the booking and client record. This is an illustrative evaluation, not evidence of clinical suitability.

All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a treatment room and practitioner
sections.title_zh: 示例：治疗室与服务人员
sections.en:
A clinic evaluating a session should model the practitioner, location and room as separate constraints. BookSteam describes resource reservations and assignment of services, classes or workshops to locations and staff. Build an intake form for the information needed before the visit, then inspect the booking and client record. This is an illustrative evaluation, not evidence of clinical suitability.

Try the same room at an occupied time and a booking that crosses a preparation buffer. The feature page also advertises deliberately overlapping appointments. Because overlap can be useful or undesirable, verify the settings for your actual workflow rather than assuming every configuration prevents double booking.
sections.zh:
诊所评估一次服务时，应分别考虑服务人员、地点和房间的限制。BookSteam 介绍资源预留，以及把服务、班课或工作坊分配到地点与员工。可按到访前所需资料设计信息收集表单，再核对预约及客户记录。这是说明性评估，并不能证明适合医疗场景。

建议尝试已占用房间的时段，以及跨越准备缓冲的预约。功能页也宣传主动重叠安排预约。重叠可能有用，也可能不合适，因此应验证实际流程的设置，不能默认所有配置都会防止重复占用。

sections.en:
The vendor describes client accounts for booking, rescheduling and cancellation, along with customizable intake fields, email/SMS notifications and local-time scheduling. Those are different parts of the customer journey: a successful booking does not establish that a later change updated the calendar and reminder correctly.

In evaluation, move an appointment and compare the staff calendar, customer confirmation and deposit state. Calendar synchronization with Apple, Google and Microsoft is listed, but the page does not establish every conflict-resolution or retry rule. Confirm the intended direction before relying on an external calendar as the sole source of truth.
sections.zh:
厂商介绍客户账户中的预约、改期和取消，以及可配置资料字段、邮件/短信通知和当地时间排程。这些属于客户旅程的不同环节：预约成功，不能证明之后的修改也正确更新了日历和提醒。

评估时可移动一次预约，对照员工日历、客户确认和订金状态。页面列出与 Apple、Google 和 Microsoft 日历同步，但没有说明所有冲突解决或重试规则。把外部日历作为唯一权威前，应确认同步方向。

sections.title_en: Staff and locations drive the tier
sections.en:
The monthly pricing view lists Solo at $19.95 for one staff member and two locations, Standard at $29.95 for five and five, Plus at $49.95 for ten and ten, and Premium at $79.95 for 35 and 35. Each lists unlimited bookings. The displayed dollar sign is retained without asserting an unshown currency code or a final taxed checkout amount.

Memberships cost extra: the listed monthly add-on runs from $5 on Solo to $20 on Premium. Included SMS depends on destination: Solo lists 100 messages for the USA/Canada but ten elsewhere; the page also provides different starting overage rates. A business outside the USA/Canada should not budget from the larger headline allowance. Payment-processor charges require separate checking.
sections.zh:
月付定价视图列出：Solo $19.95，含一位员工和两个地点；Standard $29.95，含五位员工和五个地点；Plus $49.95，含十位员工和十个地点；Premium $79.95，含 35 位员工和 35 个地点。各档均列出预约次数不限。本文保留页面显示的货币符号，不认定未显示的货币代码或最终含税结算额。

会员功能另收费：月度附加费从 Solo 的 $5 到 Premium 的 $20。短信额度随目的地变化：Solo 对美国/加拿大列出 100 条，其他国家为十条；页面也给出不同超额起始单价。美国/加拿大以外的业务不能按较大的宣传额度预算。支付处理商费用仍需单独核实。

sections.en:
The pricing page title still mentions a 30-day trial, while the body repeatedly says 14 days with no credit card required. Treat 14 days as the currently displayed offer to verify at signup; do not silently carry the title’s longer duration into a purchasing decision.

Prepare staff, locations, services, resource requirements, opening hours and buffer minutes. Connect a payment processor only after deciding deposit and no-show policies. Test on an appropriate non-production booking: the feature page advertises charging and storing cards through processors, but this research did not verify refund automation or obtain a paid account.
sections.zh:
定价页面标题仍提到 30 天试用，但正文反复写明无需信用卡的 14 天试用。注册时应以当前正文的 14 天优惠为待确认条件，不能直接把标题中较长的天数用于采购决策。

准备员工、地点、服务、资源要求、营业时间及缓冲分钟数。确定订金与爽约政策后再连接支付处理商。测试应使用适当的非生产预约：功能页宣传通过处理商扣款和保存卡信息，但本次未验证退款自动化，也未开通付费账户。

sections.title_zh: 运营适配与未测试边界
sections.en:
A service business with multiple staff or locations can evaluate the combined scheduling and customer administration. Someone needing only a one-off meeting poll may find the resource, inventory and invoice functions irrelevant. The vendor also lists online meeting links, which do not by themselves turn BookSteam into a video-conferencing infrastructure service.

The read material describes an online product, not a verified self-hosted distribution. Specific interface-language coverage, retention, export completeness and licence terms need confirmation. If notifications or processor updates fail, check the underlying booking before repeating a charge; no delivery or recovery guarantee was tested here.
sections.zh:
有多位员工或多个地点的服务企业，可评估这套排程与客户管理组合。只需一次性会议投票的人，可能无需资源、库存及发票功能。厂商也列出在线会议链接，但这本身不会使 BookSteam 成为视频会议基础设施服务。

已读材料介绍在线产品，未核实自托管发行版。具体界面语言、保留期限、导出完整性与许可条款仍需确认。通知或处理商更新失败时，应先检查原预约再考虑重复扣款；本文未测试送达或恢复保证。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Trial title says 30 days whereas the pricing body repeatedly says 14; signup terms need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 试用标题为 30 天，定价正文反复为 14 天，需在注册时确认。

research_gaps.en: Currency code, tax, processor charges, refunds, calendar conflict handling, security/regulatory suitability, export and contractual licence were not verified in a live account.
research_gaps.zh: 未在实际账户核实货币代码、税费、处理商费用、退款、日历冲突处理、安全合规适用性、导出及合同许可。
